thread:
Carmen: Kicking off Nightingale Labs case study. They signed the NDA and want a short launch package + a technical benchmark deep dive.

Ibrahim: Nice. I'll take scheduling. Do they want a recorded interview or written Q&A?

Priya: They prefer a recorded interview (30m) and a follow-up written cert for the numbers. Said unit-cost was ~2.5x lower and p95 latency improved ~35% after moving to Redwood.

Eli: Can we get the baseline config? Nightingale compared from Mistral-7B fp16 on A100 to our deployed Llama-2-13B q5_1 on A10.

Maya: Draft interview guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/NightingaleDraft. Also need a header quote from their Head of ML.

Carmen: I'll request a CEO + Head of ML slot. Prefer Wed morning PT. Who needs to prep?

Ibrahim: I'll send the invite with consent. Include verbal consent + permission to clip for social.

LegalBot: Use 'Customer Testimonial Release v3'. Submit for redline within 72 hours. Also ensure claims use qualifying language if metrics are not fully audited.

Priya: They asked for a blog + a 20-30m webinar demo. Can we align webinar dates with launch? Suggest publish blog on Mon, webinar Thurs the same week.

Maya: OK tentative timeline: interview Wed, draft to customer Thu, legal review Fri, publish Mon, webinar Thurs. Will add slack reminder for dry-run 2 days before webinar.

Eli: Engineering needs to confirm the 2.5x cost figure comes from combined batching + 8x KV cache hit in their traces. @Ibrahim can you capture that in the follow-up cert?

Ibrahim: Yep will request an artifact and ask them to sign.

Carmen: Assets requested by customer: 1) one pull quote 2) two screenshots 3) short demo clip (20s).

Maya: We'll create a staging page: https://redwood.com/case-study/nightingale-staging. Noah can you upload assets? (Noah is on rotation; will ping separately).

Priya: Webinar plan: 10m intro + 20m demo (Nightingale use-case) + 15m QA. Need ops to set up registration form and lead routing.

Maya: Lead routing: route webinar signups to AE queue for EMEA + NA. Add a post-webinar nurture with the case study PDF.

LegalBot: Wording suggestion: prefer 'approximately 2.5x' or 'around two-and-a-half times' rather than raw numeric claims. Add perf appendix for detailed numbers.

Eli: I'll prepare a perf appendix and a short methods blurb about test harness and traffic shaping. Will include raw charts.

Carmen: Customer insisted on reviewing final blog copy and the webinar slides. Add a review step for them in the timeline.

Ibrahim: Invite sent with consent language: 'Redwood may use recorded interview and excerpts for marketing and promotional purposes worldwide.'

Maya: Pre-call checklist in the invite: quick mic check, demo credentials, slide deck link, legal template link.

Priya: For social, propose a hero stat: 'Nightingale Labs cut inference unit cost by approximately 2.5x.' Legal review required.

Maya: Action items: Ibrahim - invites + consent; Eli - perf appendix + slides; Carmen - coordinate CEO/Head of ML; Priya - webinar ops + registration; Maya - draft blog + social copy; LegalBot - template reminder.

Ibrahim: Customer asked us to include a one-paragraph technical sidebar about quantization choices. Eli will handle.

Eli: Sidebar draft will include config: "Llama-2-13B q5_1 runtime on A10 with Redwood continuous batching and prefix KV cache."

LegalBot: Reminder: upload raw transcript to /share/legal-cases and tag "Nightingale". Also set embargo metadata field or release pipeline will skip.

Maya: Added embargo_date: 2026-07-06 in doc metadata. Will finalize after legal OK.

Carmen: Scheduling confirmed for Wed 09:30 PT. Thanks all.

Priya: Ops note: set webinar lead-routing to 'EMEA-first' timezone for the registration form to avoid duplicate assignments.

Maya: Closing loop: I'll push final draft to the doc and ping for redline. Reopen thread if blockers appear.

Eli: 44d

Carmen: Thanks team!
